description: This Java source file defines an Android activity named WindowSurface that demonstrates direct drawing on a Surface using a separate drawing thread. It includes class definitions for the activity, an inner class for the drawing thread, and a static inner class for moving points that animate on the surface.

classes.name: WindowSurface
classes.description: An Android activity demonstrating how to take over the window's surface for custom drawing using a separate thread.

classes.name: DrawingThread
classes.description: Inner class that extends Thread, responsible for continuously drawing animated lines on the surface.

classes.name: MovingPoint
classes.description: Static inner class representing a point that moves randomly within the surface, used to animate lines.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, requests the surface, and starts the drawing thread.

methods.name: surfaceCreated
methods.description: Callback invoked when the surface is created; assigns the surface to the drawing thread.

methods.name: surfaceChanged
methods.description: Callback for surface size or format changes; no implementation needed here.

methods.name: surfaceRedrawNeeded
methods.description: Callback indicating a redraw is needed; no implementation here.

methods.name: surfaceDestroyed
methods.description: Callback for surface destruction; tells the drawing thread to stop.
